next_authorized_action: Materialize and qualify static cliff/step schedules for every frozen candidate adapter in both immutable snapshots under these rules, source-only. Do not query Binance or compute market outcomes in that step.

prior_provider_route_gate.interpretation: This classification applies to the previously hand-selected provider adapter set only. Thresholds remain unchanged. Full static coverage remediation was opened because the adapter selection was demonstrably incomplete before any market outcome access.

qualification_rules.amount_rule: scheduled_unlock_tokens must be finite and > 0 in source token units
qualification_rules.candidate_universe_rule: Every protocols/*.ts file enumerated in the frozen static coverage receipts with at least one manualCliff, manualStep, literal cliff type, or literal step type pattern. No token/file may be added or removed based on Binance availability or later market outcomes.
qualification_rules.cross_snapshot_conflict: If the same resolved token identity + exact timestamp has differing amounts or materially conflicting static schedule semantics, mark SOURCE_CONFLICT and exclude from the qualified manifest until reconciled. Do not pick a preferred amount after seeing market outcomes.
qualification_rules.cross_snapshot_deduplication: For identical resolved token identity + exact timestamp + exact total amount, keep the earliest immutable known_at snapshot as authority and retain later snapshot as corroboration.
qualification_rules.date_boundary: scheduled_at_utc <= 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z and >= snapshot known_at + 30 days; no 2025 or 2026 row may be serialized
qualification_rules.identity_rule: Token identity must be reproducible from adapter token metadata plus adapter/source provenance. Empty, placeholder, conflicting or ambiguous identity is excluded fail-closed and receipted.
qualification_rules.pit_rule: known_at_utc must be at least 30*86400 seconds before scheduled_at_utc
qualification_rules.provenance_rule: Each included event must retain snapshot repo, exact commit, adapter path, source URL(s), known_at_utc and immutable adapter content hash where available.
qualification_rules.route_stage_after_manifest: Only after the full provider manifest and exclusions are frozen may Binance Data Vision CHECKSUM metadata be checked for the complete qualified manifest, without opening kline values.
qualification_rules.same_snapshot_aggregation: Within one snapshot, components for the same resolved token identity and exact timestamp are summed; component count/sections/kinds/source adapter are retained.
qualification_rules.timestamp_rule: exact numeric/static release timestamp must be reproducible from the immutable snapshot; date-only reconstruction is insufficient
qualification_rules.unparseable_candidate: Every frozen candidate file must end in INCLUDED, NO_ELIGIBLE_STATIC_EVENT_IN_WINDOW, DYNAMIC_OR_CONTINUOUS_ONLY, IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS, SOURCE_CONFLICT, or TECHNICAL_FAILURE. Silent drops are forbidden.
